---
title: "Quick start to write a script querying a language model"
---

Configure DSPy with a model:

```python
import dspy
dspy.configure(lm=dspy.LM(model="litellm_proxy/anthropic/Claude Opus 5",
                           api_base="https://api_url/litellm",
                           api_key="your-key-here"))
```  

Analyze a string:

```python
from arsgrammatica import analyze_passage
sentences, results = analyze_passage("Gallia est omnis divisa in partes tres.")
```


Analyze an entire citable corpus from a CEX source file:

```python
from arsgrammatica import analyze_ctsdata
sentences, results = analyze_ctsdata("corpus.cex")
```


See the [guides section](../guides/) for examples of how to use results of an analysis.
